Summary.en: Embeds a local-AI chat widget into the tagged container (requires a configured LLAMA server).
Summary.de: Bettet ein Chat-Widget der lokalen KI in den markierten Container ein (erfordert einen konfigurierten LLAMA-Server).
Summary.it: Integra un widget di chat dell'IA locale nel contenitore contrassegnato (richiede un server LLAMA configurato).

Parameter.MaxPages: Maximum number of PDF pages to process (default: 5). Set to 0 for no limit.
Parameter.Rotation: Image rotation in degrees (90, 180 or 270). 0 or unset means the rotation is unknown.
Parameter.MaxPixelSize: Maximum total pixel budget (width x height). Larger images are downscaled client-side preserving aspect ratio. Default: 3211264. Set to 0 to disable downscaling.
Parameter.LLAMAbubble: Background color for the Llama (AI) chat bubbles (default: #e5e5ea).
Parameter.UserBubble: Background color for the user chat bubbles (default: #0b93f6).
Parameter.WelcomeText: Text shown after the model name(s) in the ready message (default: 'Chat ready. Attach file(s) and type your question.').
Parameter.WaitingText: Text shown while waiting for the AI server to become available (default: 'Waiting for AI server...').
Parameter.LowConfidenceText: Warning text shown when the AI response has low confidence (default: 'Low Confidence').
Parameter.RethinkButtonText: Button label offering to re-answer with the thinking model (default: 'Rethink').
Parameter.UncertainText: Tooltip text shown when hovering over uncertain (low-confidence) tokens (default: 'Low confidence').
Parameter.ShowUncertainTokens: Whether to visually highlight uncertain tokens in AI responses. Set to 'false' to disable highlighting (default: 'true').
Parameter.VoiceHotkey: Keyboard shortcut to toggle voice input, e.g. 'Alt+A' (default: 'Alt+A'). Format: modifier(s) + key separated by '+'.
Parameter.VoicePlaceholder: Placeholder text shown in the chat input when voice input is available (default: 'Alt+A = mic on/off | Alt+Q = mic off + send').
Parameter.VoiceSendHotkey: Keyboard shortcut to stop recording and send, e.g. 'Alt+Q' (default: 'Alt+Q').
Parameter.Language: Language code for Whisper speech-to-text (e.g. 'de', 'en'). Empty or unset means auto-detect.
Parameter.ResponseLanguage: Two-letter ISO 639-1 code (e.g. 'de', 'fr'). When set, the AI is forced to respond in this language.
Parameter.Specialist: Name of a specialist model registered via an AI_LLAMA_STD_SPECIALIST_XXX plugin property. Routes requests to that specialist's server.
Parameter.QueueBadge: If set to 'true', shows a badge with the current queue position while waiting for inference.
Parameter.QueueText: Text appended after the queue position number in the badge (e.g. 'in queue' shows '3 in queue'). Default: empty.
Parameter.AlertOnFinishText: Text shown in the alert when inference finishes (when the alert-on-finish option is enabled).
Parameter.FilterResults: If set to 'true', enables PII filtering on Brave Search queries for this instance.
